name: Ize Kensho
source:
Likes: Rock, partying, women and having sex
Dislikes: Studying, serious things

Main protagonist in [url=/c79565]Harukaze's[/url] scenario.

He just joined an advertising and PR business company and ends up working next to Harukaze, who aggressively looks down on him and constantly gets angry at him.
